```yaml
name: Benchmark v2 set

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      task_count:
        description: 'Number of tasks to run (1‑10)'
        required: false
        default: '2'
        type: number
      agent:
        description: 'Agent type'
        required: false
        default: 'default-agent'
        type: string
      provider:
        description: 'Provider type'
        required: false
        default: 'default-provider'
        type: string
      model:
        description: 'Model name'
        required: false
        default: 'default-model'
        type: string
      timeout:
        description: 'Timeout in minutes'
        required: false
        default: '30'
        type: number

jobs:
  get_tasks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      tasks: ${{ steps.get_tasks.outputs.tasks }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Get top reward task IDs
        id: get_tasks
        run: |
          echo "tasks=$(jq -c '. | map(.id) | .[0:${{ inputs.task_count }}]' data/v2-top-reward-tasks.json)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

  benchmark:
    needs: get_tasks
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        task_id: ${{ fromJSON(needs.get_tasks.outputs.tasks) }}
      max-parallel: 1
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Bun
        run: |
          curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash
          echo "$HOME/.bun/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bun install

      - name: Run benchmark
        run: |
          bun run scripts/benchmark-v2.ts \
            --task-id ${{ matrix.task_id }} \
            --agent ${{ inputs.agent }} \
            --provider ${{ inputs.provider }} \
            --model ${{ inputs.model }} \
            --timeout ${{ inputs.timeout }}
        timeout-minutes: ${{ inputs.timeout }}
```
